panels.title: Project version reported by each vehicle (latest)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "text")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel == "CdhCore.version.ProjectVersion")
  |> group(columns: ["vehicle"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "vehicle", "_value"])
  |> group()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel == "Ref.SG1.Output")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "vehicle"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel == "CdhCore.cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "vehicle"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel == "Ref.fpySeq.SequencesSucceeded")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "vehicle"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel == "Ref.fpySeq.SequencesFailed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "vehicle"])
